t: What to Consider When Buying Real Estate Promissory Notes | Insights | Holland & Knight
s: A note purchase is a type of transaction whereby the holder of a promissory note secured by property sells the right to receive repayment from the borrower under the note along with the security interest in the property that secures such repayment. In other words, instead of buying the property itself, investors purchase the promissory note and the mortgage.
